entry.title: BIP Draft Post-Quantum Address Format (bc1z) using ML-DSA-65
entry.summary:
Over the past several years, multiple proposals for post-quantum (PQ) output types have been submitted to the Bitcoin BIPs repository and discussed in community platforms. A review of these efforts reveals a recurring pattern: despite substantial review time, many PQ-output initiatives failed to progress beyond initial submission or discussion stages. Examples include various pull requests such as [#1830](https://github.com/bitcoin/bips/pull/1830), [#1832](https://github.com/bitcoin/bips/pull/1832), [#2147](https://github.com/bitcoin/bips/pull/2147), [#2176](https://github.com/bitcoin/bips/pull/2176), and [#2194](https://github.com/bitcoin/bips/pull/2194). Discussions have also unfolded on forums like DelvingBitcoin, with threads such as [New Post-Quantum Bitcoin Proposal Using Winternitz-Lamport Auth Chains](https://delvingbitcoin.org/t/new-post-quantum-bitcoin-proposal-using-winternitz-lamport-auth-chains/2525) and [P2WOTS Post-Quantum UTXO Winternitz Signatures](https://delvingbitcoin.org/t/p2wots-post-quantum-utxo-winternitz-signatures/2530).
In contrast, successful proposals introducing new output types can be studied through established BIPs, including [BIP-0016](https://github.com/bitcoin/bips/blob/master/bip-0016.mediawiki), [BIP-0141](https://github.com/bitcoin/bips/blob/master/bip-0141.mediawiki), [BIP-0341](https://github.com/bitcoin/bips/blob/master/bip-0341.mediawiki), and [BIP-0360](https://github.com/bitcoin/bips/blob/master/bip-0360.mediawiki). Each of these documents exemplifies what is required for an output type proposal to advance within the Bitcoin protocol.
For those interested in the most advanced attempts to introduce post-quantum cryptographic (PQC) signature schemes to Bitcoin, the draft specification hosted at [SHRINCS.md](https://github.com/SHRINCS/shrincs-bip/blob/main/SHRINCS.md) provides a comprehensive reference. Additionally, broader discussions and challenges related to PQC output types are explored in depth in the thread [PQC Output Type Discussion](https://delvingbitcoin.org/t/pqc-output-type-discussion/2749/40).
The landscape of PQC for Bitcoin remains both rich and challenging. Engaging with this domain demands significant technical investment and patience, as achieving tangible results typically requires far more than superficial exploration or rapid iteration. Those willing to contribute will find ample work and ongoing debates, reflecting the complexity and importance of integrating quantum-resistant features into Bitcoin’s foundational structures.
